modDescription: Adds 6-way unit facing for ground units: units keep their facing when attacked, flank and rear attacks deal more damage (front x1.0, flank x1.25, rear x1.5, set in FacingConfig.json), a chevron on each counter shows the facing, '.' and ',' turn the selected unit in place for 1 MP, and AI units turn toward the nearest enemy at the end of their turn.
